fixes_applied: Hid the fixed mobile quick-action bar on /contact, where equivalent order/menu/call/directions links already exist in the page content flow.
Made contact page phone and email clickable via tel:/mailto: links.
Replaced customer-visible preview/source-artifact phrasing with restaurant-safe digital-guide language.
Re-ran production build, typecheck, route/render checks, and vision QA; mobile contact form now stacks Name → Email → Subject → Message cleanly.
remaining_risks: No public Vercel/deployed preview URL is attached yet; QA round 1 used local production server at http://127.0.0.1:3051.
Day-by-day/holiday hours remain unverified beyond the official contact-form 9:00 AM–11:30 PM window.
Catering/private-event capacity and service details remain unverified; keep call-to-confirm language.
Preferred ordering provider should be confirmed before public launch.
Owner/founder story and spelling should be verified before making it a sales claim.
